scope: Additive source recheck for Royal Gem L1-18 active healing. It changes no frozen level or Core combat rule.
game_version: The official 2023 launch identifies the ability; the post-February-2025 HP/DPS values have primary numeric evidence. The checked heal pages disclose no reliable September 2026 client build or event-order contract.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Royal Gem is equipped by Royal Champion and heals her when the ability is used.
sources.limitations: The page gives no per-level heal amounts, heal cap, activation phase or simultaneous damage/death order.

sources.title: Royal Gem — Hero Equipment
sources.version: Page read on 2026-09-23; source client build and last update date unpublished
facts: The page displays L1-18 HP/DPS bonus values matching the official post-buff table, while every Heal column entry is blank.
sources.limitations: Blank display cells cannot establish zero healing or a current per-level heal amount; the page inventory lists 41 Equipment items rather than the independently verified 42.

sources.title: Royal Gem: Clash of Clans Hero Equipment item Stats, Levels & Cost
sources.version: Page read on 2026-09-23; last update date and client build unpublished
facts: The page identifies Royal Gem self-healing and L18 HP bonus 570, and says its statistics derive from the same clash-of-clans-data upstream used by the frozen payload.
sources.limitations: It does not display a heal-per-level field in the checked page and is not independent current-client corroboration of the pinned heal series.

sources.title: Royal Gem - Clash of Clans Guide
sources.version: Page gives no build and warns values may change before update release
facts: The page prints an L1-18 heal-on-activation series of 363-2720, which differs from the frozen 1200-2400 healthRecovery series.
sources.limitations: The page itself warns values can change before release, gives no client version and cannot resolve current Royal Gem healing.

sources.title: Royal Gem (Birlikler) — Clash of Clans
sources.version: No client build or publication date verified
facts: A search-index snippet shows the frozen 1200-2400 heal series alongside the post-buff HP/DPS values.
sources.limitations: Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403; the source build, extraction date and independence from the pinned raw payload could not be checked. No raw SHA-256 is claimed.

derivations.result: Current per-level active healing remains unverified; retain the frozen 1200-2400 series as data-only and keep the Core effect disabled.
derivations.method: Compare the accessible current-reference tables, their provenance statements and the historical divergent heal table against the pinned raw series. None supplies a build-pinned current heal value or deterministic event phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use blank Heal cells as zero healing
rejected_inferences.reason: The official launch explicitly identifies active healing; blanks indicate unavailable display data.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the Clash Troops page as independent September 2026 confirmation of 1200-2400
rejected_inferences.reason: It names the same upstream data project and does not show the active heal series.

rejected_inferences.rule: Replace frozen levels with the CoC Guide 363-2720 series
rejected_inferences.reason: The page is unversioned and explicitly warns its numbers may predate a release.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat a search snippet behind HTTP 403 as verified current-client values
rejected_inferences.reason: The page and underlying source file could not be inspected.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal immediately on the Hero ability command tick
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source establishes the heal phase, cap, death interaction or stable ordering with simultaneous damage.

items: build-pinned current heal amounts at every level
activation command and first heal tick
ordering with damage, defeat, Phoenix and a second Equipment effect
Viewer activation overlay, snapshot, replay and RL future-state contract

conclusion: Royal Gem active healing remains partial. Official ability identity and HP/DPS bonuses are sourced, but these checked sources do not establish a current deterministic heal contract; no Core heal is enabled.
